17 Power to obtain information from doctors, pharmacists etc. in certain
circumstances.

(1) If it appears to the Secretary of State that there exists in any area in Great Britain
a social problem caused by the extensive misuse of dangerous or otherwise harmful
drugs in that area, he may by notice in writing served on any doctor or pharmacist

(a) in the case of a doctor, were prescribed, administered or supplied by him;
(b) in the case of a pharmacist, were supplied by him; or
(c) in the case of a person carrying on a retail pharmacy business, were supplied in
the course of that business at any premises so situated which may be specified
in the notice.
